findings.observation: The strong angled sunlight on the left wall and shelf is removed. Broad diffuse room light now fits the presenter's broadly lit face more plausibly. The room remains directional enough to read as window-lit.

Softer window, shelf and book detail competes less with the face. The original facial image remains soft, and the synthetic outer shirt still has more visible texture than the central collar. No further blanket skin warming or brightening is justified by these stills.

Full-size 0.4-second inspection shows intact glasses, recognizable hair silhouette and ears. No conspicuous new bright outline, transparent hole or duplicated face is visible. A faint localized temple/ear contour remains. Fine hair preservation cannot be established from these sampled stills.

Window, shelf bowl, central wall, bookcase and vase retain their composition. Presenter scale, position and sampled poses remain consistent. This is visual correspondence, not a claim that the generated room plate is pixel-identical.

recommendation: Render Candidate B for owner review without another treatment change. In the encoded motion review, check temporal hair/ear edges and shoulder-to-collar integration.
limits: This is a sampled still review, not a full-motion or final encoded-video review.
Temporal matte shimmer, all-frame clipping and audio/performance synchronization were not assessed in this pass.
